Brew-Ready.dc.html.title: Brew 3 · Extraction, waiting for the pump

noteA.text:
Instrument — chosen by the user on 4 Oct 2026.

Instrument

Monospaced tabular numbers, hairline rules, square corners, one signal orange. Reads like lab equipment, which fits an app built on raw packets and post-hoc analysis.

Best at: dense data (probe, history, charts) and staying calm on every screen.
Risk: can feel cold. The live numbers rely on size, not colour.
Fonts: SF Mono and SF Pro on iPhone (0 kB). Elsewhere IBM Plex.
Tweaks: dark mode, progress ruler.

noteB.text:
Crema

Dark-roast background, crema-gold accent, rounded numerals, soft cards, a ring gauge for the shot. Dark first, so it's easy on the eyes at 6 am.

Best at: feeling like a coffee product you want to open every morning.
Risk: brown on brown needs contrast discipline. The ring takes space that the numbers could use.
Fonts: SF Rounded on iPhone (0 kB). Elsewhere Nunito.
Tweaks: light mode, ring gauge.

noteC.text:
Native

Grouped inset lists, large titles, segmented controls and switches. Follows iOS conventions so closely it could be a built-in app.

Best at: zero learning curve, cheapest to build and keep consistent, and it suits the 'rudimentary until T3.5' rule.
Risk: no identity of its own, and it looks off on desktop Chrome.
Fonts: SF Pro (system, 0 kB).
Tweaks: dark mode, progress bar.

noteD.text:
Signal

Giant condensed numerals on black. The screen fills from the bottom like the cup as the shot nears its target. The direction tap uses three huge colour blocks, easy to hit with wet hands.

Best at: the spec's peripheral-vision rule and the two-tap rule.
Risk: loud on the calmer screens (history, probe), and it needs a webfont (about 15 kB, digits subset).
Fonts: Barlow Condensed.
Tweaks: light mode, screen fill.

titleC.text: C · Native — looks like a built-in iPhone app

titleD.text: D · Signal — readable from across the kitchen

v2Q1.text:
Home and History (round 4)

Look: A · Instrument (chosen). Every board has Mode (auto, light, dark) in its Tweaks; the Look tweak keeps Crema for reference. In Play, the tab bar, rows and back links move between boards.

• Home: the scale, its battery and the live weight; tap Tare. Tweak scale: idle / container (a known container opens its phase) / disconnected. Then the maintenance reminder, the last shot and the last 7 days (averages, taste split).
• History: date, time, drink, a small graph and the taste. Tweak compareMode picks two shots.
• Shot detail: the big graph, every metric, the phases against their targets, the grades (editable) and the snapshot as it was at brew time.
• Compare: both curves, aligned at pump on or first drip, and an A Δ B table.

v2Q2.text:
Brew: phases follow the containers

• Beans, Grind, Extraction, Milk. Only the cup and the extraction are required; a skipped phase reads 'skipped' on the shot card. The stepper on top switches by hand. A lift is a pause.
• Each phase shows its context, last used by default; a change becomes the default. Beans: machine, basket (the target), pack. Grind: grinder and setting. Extraction: recipe (the ratio). Milk: the recipe's milk ratio.
• Every pour shows progress to its target; past +1.0 g it turns to the warning colour.
• The nudge on Beans is the only pointer: 'Last time it was sour: grind a little finer'. ✕ hides it.

Tweaks: Beans state / picker / nudge; Ready pumpDetection (microphone / manual) / picker; Extraction state (running / over); Shot card milk (pending / added / skipped) / grindSkipped.

v2Q3.text:
Setup (round 4)

• Machine: pressure (optional), several baskets (id + size; the size is the beans target), and the descale and backflush dates with reminders.
• Grinders: brand, model, stepless or clicks, current setting, and the grinder-care date.
• Recipes: a coffee ratio and an optional milk ratio; a milk ratio makes it a milk drink and brings the milk phase. Tweak editing.
• Coffee packs: brand, name, weight, roast date (required), open date, flavours. No stock. Finishing a pack asks 'buy again' (optional). Tweak finishing.
• Every shot records the context as it was: pack dates, machine, pressure, basket, grinder and setting, recipe, maintenance dates.

v2Q4.text:
Setup, continued

• Containers: weigh the empty container, name it, give it roles (bean cup, grind cup, cup, milk jug). Nearest wins; the same weight is a conflict; within 3 g, a dismissible warning.
• Tags: one list; default tags are on for every new shot. 'Experiment' marks shots to filter out later.
• Microphone: listens for the pump and the grinder; calibrate each once (Tweak calibrating). Off means tap to start the shot. Only sound levels are kept, never audio.

v2Row2.text: Brew: a container on the scale opens its phase; the shot card collects them
